title: Chapter 365 Defeating The Enemy
content:
Chapter 365 Defeating The Enemy

As soon as the golden-red sword was deployed, it was really effective. It broke the formation that almost made tens of thousands of troops feel desperate.

And the movement is unexpectedly agile, but one blow has such a miraculous effect.

"Great, we're saved!"

"General Shenwei, these jumping clowns are vulnerable."

"I survived."

Countless noisy voices sounded, and all the soldiers below wept with joy, and staged a scene of life.

Farther away, the 18 Black Mist men who were scattered on various hills and formed formations to strangle the army, but at the moment the formation was broken, they all sprayed a mouthful of black blood, and the whole person was sluggish, breathless. Restore the heyday just now.

The black mist dissipated immediately after five people sprayed blood, revealing a few thin figures, all with pale faces and exhausted. After careful observation, they all breathed a sigh of relief and went to see Amaterasu.

"Damn it, Keiji-kun!"

A few men in black shouted nearby, but it was extremely painful to see an acquaintance among the five fallen figures.

"Stop yelling, you will go down to accompany him soon. This group of rats who can only do small tricks in the dark dare to offend me. If you don't smash your corpses into thousands of pieces and burn your soul into Jiuyou, you will never Will not forgive."

Tomita Yoshinari stood in mid-air, and in front of him was the golden-red giant sword. At this moment, he looked at the men in black with extremely sad and indignant expressions, and sneered, with raging fireworks unstoppable in his eyes.

Obviously, he was really irritated.

This time, in order to break this deadlock, it really cost a lot. A whole 5000 Tier 2 warriors sacrificed for this, and the strength of the rest of the army was also greatly damaged, and it would take a long time to recover.

More importantly, his hope of unifying the Shinano country and winning the first victory was shattered. He didn't know how miserable the fate he faced next, so how could he not make him feel angry.

"You ants, die, and taste the anger of my lord."

Tomita Yoshinari let out an angry roar, and quickly pinched his slender fingers in his hand, and several mysterious formulas appeared.

Then the golden-red giant sword moved and slammed into the remaining 13 black mist men at such an incredible speed.

Seeing the giant sword coming, these people from the black mist were startled, but they forgot their grief and became a little frightened instead.

The power of this gigantic sword is terrifying. I saw it just now, and it broke through the formation in their eyes that was powerful enough to compare with gods and demons.

This kind of power is really terrifying, they have never heard of it, and I am afraid that only the high gods can have such power.

Now, under the command of the general, they are attacking them, how can they not be terrified.

This is definitely not a force they can resist, and everyone has this idea in their hearts.

"Damn it, retreat quickly. The situation has changed, the enemy is too strong, escape here first, and then we will discuss the future in detail."

Seeing the giant sword coming at him, the fifth-level Heiwuren master felt that it contained the power to destroy the world, penetrating into his heart, making his premonition keep spreading dangerous signals, and he couldn't help but Terrified in my heart, I hurriedly shouted towards my subordinates.

When those men reacted and were about to flee, they saw that their leader had already moved and retreated a mile away in the blink of an eye. It seemed that they could escape the battlefield with a few breaths.

"Damn it, you usually boast so bravely, but now you are running away so fast, you really have no guts."

Those who were still around and didn't have time to escape couldn't help but cursed inwardly, but they didn't dare to stay, and they used their own methods to escape at an extremely fast speed.

It's a pity that although their escape speed was fast, they couldn't match the golden giant sword that had been fully deployed.

Feijian was originally famous for its swiftness and sharpness, even though this huge sword looks very large now, it looks a bit bulky and difficult to move.

But now that he is able to display it, and he has paid such a heavy price, it is naturally impossible for him to be as bulky as it appears on the surface.

With a movement of the flying sword, it crossed the distance in the blink of an eye, and came to a black mist man who was about to escape. In his horrified eyes, the giant sword directly slashed across his body, and then Quickly flew towards the next target.

And this black man, after the giant sword was drawn, hadn't reacted yet, and didn't realize that he had been hit.

He moved his fingers, as if he was about to use his skills to escape, but then he seemed unable to control his body, and looked down.

However, countless golden-red rays of light erupted from his body all of a sudden, gushing out from all over his body, as if there were many holes in his body, and then erupted loudly, turning his whole body into flying ash.

It's not worth it for a dignified fourth-tier master, who would be respected by countless people after seeing him, to die so easily, and die without knowing it.

Afterwards, the golden-red sharp sword jumped continuously, piercing the bodies of seven people one after another. A golden light flashed in their eyes just like the person just now, and then turned into flying ash to follow.

After the golden-red giant sword pierced through the eighth man's body in the shattering formation, his whole body shook. His body seemed to have reached a certain limit, and there was a sound of metal shattering, and his body was quickly covered with cracks following the sound.

Immediately afterwards, the giant sword trembled slightly, and the whole body trembled accordingly, and finally turned into pieces and flew in the air for a while, then turned into golden light spots again and disappeared.

At the same time, the lower ranks were originally trying their best to release the internal force in their bodies to supply formations to consume maintenance, and the second-tier legion to kill the enemy with a giant sword.

They all trembled suddenly, and their bodies dried up rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye. The body that was originally full of red shields withered, and finally turned into a mummy, which was actually evacuated by the entire formation.

The ordinary soldiers around who were celebrating loudly, cheering for their general, watching their master show off his might and beheading the enemy one after another were also stunned.

Everyone was stunned, not understanding what was going on, why did the golden-red giant sword, which was showing great power just now, turn into a spot of light and disappear?

How come the second-tier warrior, who was still powerful just now and exuded a frightening spirit of blood and courage, turned into a dry corpse in an instant?

The sudden contrast stunned them.

When they realized what had happened, they couldn't help but feel chills running down their spines, and took a few breaths in their hearts.

These powerful samurai lords, the comrades who fought together just now, were actually drained by their generals to supply the consumption of the golden red giant sword.
